plan: Deep-copy and validate the workspace tree at construction.
Use recursive traversal for word counts, unresolved markers, and outlines.
Perform moves on a candidate copy and commit only after all validation succeeds.
mechanisms: Recursive validation enforces item schemas, container rules, and globally unique string IDs.
Regular expressions remove marker tokens before word counting and extract marker identifiers.
Depth-first traversal preserves deterministic item order and indentation.
Copy-on-write move logic guarantees failed moves leave workspace data unchanged.
